reports.title: ADVANCED DRAINAGE SYSTEMS ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: Based on results to date, current visibility, backlog of existing orders and business trends, the Company updated its financial targets for fiscal 2027. Net sales are now expected to be in the range of $3.300 billion to $3.400 billion and Adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be in the range of $1.000 billion to $1.030 billion. Capital expenditures are expected to be approximately $200 million.
